content: Do I need to lift heavy to build muscle?

No, you don't have to lift heavy to build muscle. Research shows that sets taken close to failure build similar muscle across a wide range of loads, roughly 5 to 30 reps, as long as the effort is high. Heavy lifting still matters for your bench goal, though. Strength is specific, so you'll need to train heavy (around 1-6 reps) to get to 100 kg. 💪

My suggestion is to do your main bench work heavy and your accessories in the 8-15 rep range.
